scope.analysis: Retrospective balanced static Boltz-2 models, 50 model indices 0-49 per variant and modeled register; nine variants per stratum.
scope.protocol: Historical Boltz-2 plus reported Amber/OpenMM relaxation and post-relaxation interface scores. Keep PA6 and PA66 campaigns separate. This is not MD or the newer RESP/GAFF2 protonation campaign.
scope.matching_limits: Predictor/register/model budget/reported relaxation source are matched within each source campaign. Per-model topology, proton inventory and parameter-file identity are not certified by a metrics CSV.
scope.gate_policy: Historical inclusive Tier B geometry thresholds are frozen. Herschlag phi sign is reported separately; no new orientation rejection gate is introduced retrospectively.
scope.chemical_integrity: This summary reuses published internal metrics; it does not independently certify model valence, maturation, topology or structural integrity.
scope.model_denominators: Models and equivalent sites are not independent experimental variants. No model-level binomial interval is interpreted as assay uncertainty.
scope.activity_direction: Product-specific fold values are descriptive reported signals, not measured kcat or total conversion. No threshold tuning, classifier training or ROC/AUC is authorized.

assay_caveats: Actual experimental substrates were polymer powders. Legacy comparison strings describe modeled registers and product endpoints, not proof of isolated L4 or L2 substrate turnover.
Derived curated WT-relative activity table is available; primary assay replicates, numerical uncertainty, detection limits and complete construct sequences have not been located.
A reported zero product signal is not confirmed enzyme inactivity. F101E/F101H have positive alternative PA6 product signals.
WT activity=1 is a normalization convention, not an additional raw measurement. Never combine fold values for different products into a total activity.

Crude lysate assays were reported at 75 degrees C for 6 h in 200 mM Tris reported pH 8; MD is approximately 300 K. Active-enzyme abundance, maturation and substrate accessibility can affect endpoints.

PI identifies K59E discordant duplicate experiments in cb150_nyl12_ssl_sites_1_4_pa6_pa66_pmaxa.xlsx. Keep experiments separate, establish replicate type, and treat all fold rankings as provisional; do not select/average one observation silently.
